title: What you owe once it is listed

hotspots.label: Listing
hotspots.detail: The Custom Connector Intake Form v2 gathers what is needed to publish a partner-built connector on the Glean Connectors webpage.

hotspots.label: Documentation
hotspots.detail: Customer-facing documentation must explain the connector's permission propagation logic.

hotspots.label: Support
hotspots.detail: Glean expects the partner to maintain and support a listed connector. Shared push connector code may have limited support, so say who supports what.

hotspots.label: Confirmation
hotspots.detail: Request written confirmation that permissions and security meet expectations once a custom test group has reviewed the results.
